equipment.name: Indigo Collar or Short Cloak
equipment.detail: A small dark garment sized for Hinosuke.

equipment.name: Gold Bell
equipment.detail: A small bell associated with Hinosuke's bond to Yūgen; its supernatural origin is unresolved.

visual_identity.canonical_description: A tiny pure-white kitsune spirit with blue eyes, luminous blue markings, large triangular ears, a small indigo collar or cloak, a gold bell, exactly one fluffy white tail, and cold blue foxfire.
never_change: Never give Hinosuke more than one tail
Never portray him as a player character or generic pet

background.personality: Playful, loyal, active, curious, and quietly wise.
background.voice_guidance: Use movement, expression, familiar-bond impressions, and small sounds. Exact speech capability remains unresolved.
